resident_recovery_checks.root_cause: Backup browsing and restore previously required a successfully parsed current resident document.
resident_recovery_checks.architecture: A separate whole-file storage checkpoint survives a failed current-format read; editing still requires the unchanged strict 3.0.3 reader.
resident_recovery_checks.preservation: Unreadable current payloads and their original metadata are copied and checked separately under Unverified; neither the reserved container nor its children is a selectable restore point.
resident_recovery_checks.backup_validation: Selected inventory, version, size and main integrity/identity checks remain mandatory; raw-source fingerprints, copied payloads and restore stages are checked before atomic swap.
resident_recovery_checks.negative_cases: Invalid selected inventory/hash/version; later personal-file changes; explicit retry against a fresh checkpoint; path/pending-write guards; no success on failed post-operation reload.
